description: List ENS names that expire soon, soonest first, e.g. 'Which of nick.eth's names expire in the next 30 days?' or 'What names under ens.eth expire this month?'. Give address for one address's names (owned, managed or held through roles); then up to limit names come back in one answer, without a cursor. includeGrace adds names that already expired but are in their grace period, when they can still be renewed. Results come from an indexer and can lag the chain by a few blocks.

address.description: Ethereum address (0x…) or an ENS name resolving to one, e.g. nick.eth

cursor.description: cursor from the previous page, to read the next one

namespace.description: ens (default), or basenames for *.base.eth names on Base

parent.description: Only direct subnames of this name; with no address only

withinDays.description: Days ahead to look, 1 to 3650. Default: 30

name: list_expiring_names

asOf.description: Chain time the indexer's answer reflects

cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page; absent on the last page

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 date and time in UTC

graceEndsAt.description: End of the grace period, while the name is in it

name.description: ENS name as the user wrote it, e.g. nick.eth; normalised by the server (ENSIP-15)

status.description: active (registered), expired (in its grace period), released (can be registered again) or unregistered

partial.description: Why the answer may be incomplete

title: List expiring ENS names
